name: Oregon
agencyName: Oregon Driver and Motor Vehicle Services (DMV)

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Online: up to 2 attempts per 24 hours, 4 attempts total before you must test in a DMV office
retake.attemptCapPeriod: 4 online attempts, then in-office testing required

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours with driver education, or 100 hours without
gdl.nightCurfew: First year: no driving 12 a.m.-5 a.m. unless an exception applies
gdl.passengerLimits: First 6 months: no passengers under 20 (except immediate family). Second 6 months: no more than 3 passengers under 20 (except immediate family).

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and date of birth (e.g. birth certificate or passport)
Proof of a Social Security Number
Second document proving residence address (for REAL ID)
process.realIdNotes: Oregon offers an optional REAL ID marked with a star. A REAL ID requires proof of identity, Social Security Number, and two documents proving Oregon residence address. REAL ID is required to board domestic flights.
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: No numeric point system; suspensions are based on the number and type of convictions and crashes under the Driver Improvement Program
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane, or slow down if you cannot move over safely, for stopped emergency, tow, and roadside-assistance vehicles displaying warning lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 65 mph (70 mph on some rural eastern Oregon segments)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph when children are present or during posted hours
